# googleworkspace_dlp_detector (Resource)

Manages a Google Workspace DLP detector using the Cloud Identity Policy API. The detector setting is supplied as JSON so detector-specific fields can evolve with the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_dlp_organization_scope" "current" {}

resource "googleworkspace_dlp_detector" "goanywhere_urls" {
  org_unit_id = data.googleworkspace_dlp_organization_scope.current.organization_scope_id

  setting_type = "settings/detector.url_list"
  setting_value = jsonencode({
    displayName = "GoAnywhere URLs"
    urlList = {
      urls = ["goanywhere.example.com"]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `setting_type` (String) Cloud Identity Policy detector setting type. Supported values are URL lists, regular expressions, and word lists.
- `setting_value` (String) JSON object for the detector's `setting.value`.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Google Workspace group ID targeted by the detector. Accepts the raw ID or `groups/{id}`. Exactly one of `group_id`, `org_unit_id`, or `policy_query` is required; the scope is immutable.
- `org_unit_id` (String) ID of the Workspace organization-wide DLP scope or an organizational unit to which the detector applies. Use `googleworkspace_dlp_organization_scope` to look up the organization-wide scope. Accepts the raw ID or `orgUnits/{id}`. Exactly one of `org_unit_id`, `group_id`, or `policy_query` is required; the scope is immutable.
- `policy_query` (String) JSON object containing an advanced Cloud Identity Policy query scope. Use this instead of `org_unit_id` or `group_id` for CEL-scoped detectors. The scope is immutable.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
